decoder_contract.branch: Exact requested 3.24-main/community root and exact nested repo selection. Foreign/historical/edge states embedded by the official stable responses are data, not selected feeds or runtime package sources.
decoder_contract.duplicates: Official community response repeats identical full vulnerability documents and state IDs. Preserve raw counts, deduplicate identical evidence, reject conflicting repeated documents/state identities/source-version-CVE states. Do not conflate legitimate repeated rows with duplicate JSON object keys.
decoder_contract.types: fixed must be bool; source/version must use exact canonical official package URLs; CVE/state links and object shapes must agree; finite 0..10 scores cannot be bool.
decoder_contract.scores: Null vectors and zero scores are UNKNOWN, never safe/low. Official cvss3 field contains twelve CVSS:4.0 vectors as well as 3.0/3.1; preserve the raw field rather than rejecting or silently renaming it.
decoder_contract.installed_subject: Reuse complete query/database equality and the original virtual/unresolved partition. Require both stable repositories; group exact official source/full-APK-version matches without source-name, missing-origin or owned pseudo-version exemptions.
